headline: Grand Foundry Limited changes name to Tikona Communication Limited and symbol to TIKONA
summary: Grand Foundry Limited announced that its corporate name will officially change to Tikona Communication Limited. Concurrently, its NSE trading symbol will shift from GFSTEELS to TIKONA. The changes take effect starting October 15, 2026. Retail investors must use the new symbol for future trades.
whats_next: Symbol and name change effective October 15, 2026
why_it_matters: Use the new TIKONA symbol for trading from October 2026.

headline: Grand Foundry schedules extraordinary general meeting for October 2026
hook: Upcoming vote for Grand Foundry holders
summary: Grand Foundry Limited has issued a notice for an Extraordinary General Meeting (EGM) scheduled to take place on October 28, 2026. The company informed the stock exchange regarding the upcoming shareholder meeting. Specific agenda items for the EGM were not detailed in the initial filing. Shareholders of the company will need to review the formal meeting documents for voting particulars.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate meeting notice with no immediate financial impact.

headline: Grand Foundry reports outcome of board meeting held on October 1, 2026
hook: Routine corporate filing from Grand Foundry
summary: Grand Foundry Limited has submitted the official outcome of its board meeting held on October 1, 2026, to the stock exchange. Such procedural filings are routine regulatory requirements for listed entities. Retail investors should review the specific company disclosures for any material updates regarding operations or corporate actions. The filing ensures regulatory compliance but carries no immediate market-moving impact.
why_it_matters: Routine regulatory filing with no immediate impact on retail portfolios.
